trunk_six_suites_red.description: An isolated candidate worktree of trunk ca759bd7 carrying the six planner-verified suite breaks: single-tutorial-gate.test.ts 3 pass / 2 fail (duplicate :461, noncanonical :496 — check:snippets 'no committed binding' preempts the tutorial gate), scaffold.build.test.ts 1 pass / 1 fail (github-slugger :142 outside the TR-06 set with wrangler behind it, plus the retired three-segment pin :162), data-table-contract.test.ts 3 pass / 1 fail (rows regex :58 wants the non-optional form), ledger.spec.ts failing across tokens (112 copy triggers, replaced td.ledger-type/td.ledger-verdict/table.ledger__table selectors, 56 /components/ docs links), verdict-badge-wiring.spec.ts 6 pass / 3 fail (same replaced selectors), not-found-search-recovery.spec.ts 6 pass / 3 fail (the '[data-search-slot] button' strict-mode violation on the two JS-enabled projects), and search-contract.spec.ts 5 pass / 10 fail (every JS-enabled token in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile failing at the :208 click on the same strict-mode violation; the no-JS project passes).
records: The gitignored generated apps/docs/src/data/registry-items.json is absent in a fresh worktree and gates pnpm typecheck — copy or regenerate it via pnpm registry:build inside the worktree; never commit it.

The single-tutorial drill is a six-build, 45-minute-class run (DRILL_TIMEOUT_MS 2_700_000); the harness's per-child timeouts must respect it, and the Playwright selectors need the freshly built dist with CI=1 and a verified-free 4321 (Playwright owns the astro preview webServer).
RED is the recorded pre-change state of the seven exact selectors — failures with exit codes and failing assertions bound to the candidate SHA — never authored or hand-copied output.
The drill appends run blocks to tests/sprint-05-orient-search/evidence/ORI-CI-001/ (five logs + manifest.json); those appends are the suite's own recording contract, append-only, never hand-edited.

requirements.name: The three vitest suites pass their exact selectors in isolation
requirements.description: GIVEN trunk ca759bd7 where the three vitest selectors fail — single-tutorial-gate.test.ts 3 pass / 2 fail (ORI-CI-001-duplicate at :461 and ORI-CI-001-noncanonical at :496, the builds stopping at check:snippets 'no committed binding' before the tutorial gate, the draft variant tripping it too), scaffold.build.test.ts 1 pass / 1 fail (FUSE-01-manifest-contract at :142 on github-slugger outside the TR-06 set with wrangler behind it, and the retired three-segment pin at :162), and data-table-contract.test.ts 3 pass / 1 fail (the :58 rows regex wanting the pre-AST-007 non-optional form) WHEN the seven named test files carry the repairs THEN each of the three exact vitest selectors exits 0 in isolation — the drill's duplicate/noncanonical variants reaching ASTRO's tutorial-gate diagnostics through scratch-only COMMITTED_BINDINGS extensions (the noncanonical rename re-pointing the four quickstart entries, because the stale-binding check at authored-snippets.ts:945 rejects orphaned bindings), the manifest contract allowing exactly the landed dependency set (github-slugger from bf202aac, wrangler from 57903f51) and pinning the seven-stage build script, and the data-table contract asserting the optional rich-cell rows?: prop, the single rows?.map( loop, and the slot branch.
requirements.verification_service: the real vitest runners, the real seven-stage public docs build inside the drills' owned scratch copies, and the real check:snippets and tutorial-gate diagnostics

scenario.verification_service: the real vitest runners, the real seven-stage public docs build inside the drills' owned scratch copies, and the real check:snippets and tutorial-gate diagnostics

would_fail_if: GREEN is claimed from a source read or a hand-recorded pass instead of the harness spawning the three real vitest selectors and observing exit 0 for each.

The drill's scratch COMMITTED_BINDINGS extension is faked by editing the candidate's scripts/docs-data/authored-snippets.ts (a product-source change) instead of mutating only the owned os.tmpdir() scratch copy, or by stubbing check:snippets out of the build.

The duplicate variants stop passing because the bindings are added but the noncanonical rename leaves the four quickstart entries orphaned — the stale-binding check at authored-snippets.ts:945 preempts Astro's tutorial gate, so the '[docs-data] single-tutorial: item "tutorial-cardinality"' and canonical-destination diagnostics never appear.

The manifest contract is repaired by deleting the TR-06 boundary assertion or the banned-package negatives instead of extending the allowed set with exactly github-slugger and wrangler and superseding the build-script pin to the landed seven-stage string.
The data-table contract is repaired by deleting the rows-prop, loop-count, or slot-form assertions instead of updating them to the optional rich-cell shape.

steps: Pre-change RED: on the isolated candidate, run the three preserved vitest selectors and record the failures in red.json with the candidate SHA bound — single-tutorial-gate.test.ts exits nonzero failing ORI-CI-001-duplicate at :461 and ORI-CI-001-noncanonical at :496, scaffold.build.test.ts exits nonzero failing FUSE-01-manifest-contract at :142, data-table-contract.test.ts exits nonzero failing the rows regex at :58.

Land the three vitest-class repairs: the drill extends (duplicate, published and unpublished) or re-points (noncanonical) the scratch copy's COMMITTED_BINDINGS for the copy's four source-bound blocks; the TR-06 allowed set gains github-slugger and wrangler with the landing commits named and the build-script pin supersedes to the seven-stage string; the rows regex accepts the optional rich-cell form, asserts the slot branch, and re-anchors the loop count to rows?.map(.

Rerun the identical three selectors through the harness; confirm each exits 0 — the duplicate variant naming both source IDs with 'observed 2 versus 1', the unpublished variant exiting 0 with no gate diagnostic, the noncanonical variant carrying '[docs-data] canonical-destination', the restored build exiting 0, and the manifest/data-table tokens green.

must_observe: red.json records exactly (3) pre-change selector failures — the literal tallies 3-pass/2-fail (single-tutorial-gate.test.ts), 1-pass/1-fail (scaffold.build.test.ts), 3-pass/1-fail (data-table-contract.test.ts) — each with exit code (1) and the failing assertion text bound to the candidate SHA literal.

green.json records each of the three vitest selectors exiting 0 post-change, with the tutorial drill's five tokens all passing and the scratch gate-file mutations restored byte-exactly (restoredMatchesBaseline true, candidateUnchanged true).

The drill's duplicatePublished build output matches /[docs-data] single-tutorial: item "tutorial-cardinality"/ and contains 'observed 2 versus 1', and the noncanonical output carries /[docs-data] canonical-destination/ — ASTRO's gate speaking, not check:snippets 'no committed binding' with a (0)-diagnostic count for the tutorial gate.
must_not_observe: Any candidate-side edit to scripts/docs-data/authored-snippets.ts, apps/**, or packages/** while making the drills pass.
A check:snippets 'no committed binding' or 'stale binding' diagnostic in the repaired duplicate/noncanonical build outputs.
A deleted or skipped token, a weakened assertion, or a green claim without the real selector exits recorded.

requirements.name: The four Playwright suites pass their exact selectors against the built dist
requirements.description: GIVEN trunk where ledger.spec.ts fails across its tokens (112 copy triggers — two labeled engine commands per row since AST-007; the strict-mode bulk-add code pair; the replaced td.ledger-type, td.ledger-verdict, and table.ledger__table selectors; the docs column's 56 /components/{name} links via a[data-docs-link]), verdict-badge-wiring.spec.ts fails its ledger token in all three projects on the same replaced selectors, not-found-search-recovery.spec.ts fails its two JS-enabled projects on the '[data-search-slot] button' strict-mode violation (2 elements since VIS-003's close button landed inside the slot), and search-contract.spec.ts fails every JS-enabled token in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile at the :208 click on the same violation (5 pass / 10 fail) WHEN the four spec files carry the selector repairs adopted from the living sprint-05 lane precedents (ledger-presentation.spec.ts's row-scoped .badge, engine-scoped rnr-copy-button, and a[data-docs-link]; search-presentation.spec.ts:40's scoped trigger) THEN each of the four exact Playwright selectors exits 0 across all three projects against astro preview serving the freshly built dist, with the data-equality oracles preserved — 56 rows name-for-name against the generated dataset, the verdict vocabulary, the absolute-URL command regex, clipboard equality with the displayed command, DOM-order, and the no-JS render.
requirements.verification_service: the real Playwright runners over astro preview serving the real built dist, the real generated dataset, and the real clipboard

scenario.verification_service: the real Playwright runners over astro preview serving the real built dist, the real generated dataset, and the real clipboard

would_fail_if: GREEN is claimed from a markup read or a recorded screenshot instead of the harness spawning the four real Playwright selectors against astro preview serving the freshly built dist and observing exit 0 across all three projects.
A selector rewrite hardcodes expected row data as literals instead of deriving it from the generated apps/docs/src/data/registry-items.json dataset, so a dataset change can silently drift the oracle.

An oracle is weakened to get green — the 56-rows name-for-name equality, the verdict vocabulary ('runs in Expo Go' / 'requires a dev client'), the absolute-URL command regex, clipboard equality with the displayed command, DOM-order, or the no-JS render assertions are dropped rather than re-scoped.

The not-found recovery fix scopes the trigger selector so broadly it still multi-matches (for example '[data-search-slot] button' kept, or a form that matches the close button too) instead of the single .search-dialog__trigger element.
A suite is made green by skipping the chromium-nojs project or lowering timeouts below the lane's real settle times.

steps: Pre-change RED: run the three preserved Playwright selectors against the built dist and record the failures — ledger.spec.ts failing across tokens (112 rnr-copy-button button triggers versus 56 expected; the strict-mode bulk-add code pair; the replaced td.ledger-type, td.ledger-verdict, and table.ledger__table selectors; td.ledger-docs a never resolving), verdict-badge-wiring.spec.ts timing out in all three projects, not-found-search-recovery.spec.ts failing its two JS-enabled projects with the strict-mode violation on '[data-search-slot] button' resolved to 2 elements, and search-contract.spec.ts failing every JS-enabled token in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile at the :208 click on the same strict-mode violation (5 pass / 10 fail).

Land the three spec repairs using the living lane precedents: row-scoped .badge, engine-scoped [data-engine-command="nativewind"] rnr-copy-button selection, a[data-docs-link] with all 56 hrefs /components/{item.name}, the stripped-category td text, table.data-table under .ledger-table__scroll, the bulk-add display-code scoping, HEADER_SEARCH_TRIGGER = '[data-search-slot] button.search-dialog__trigger', and SEARCH_TRIGGER in search-contract.spec.ts taking the same scoped form.
Rebuild once (pnpm --filter @rnr-ai-elements/docs build) and rerun the identical four selectors through the harness; confirm each exits 0 across chromium-desktop, chromium-mobile, and chromium-nojs.

must_observe: ledger.spec.ts exits 0 with 56 rows name-for-name against the generated dataset, the verdict vocabulary per item.expoGo, both engine base URLs copyable with clipboard equality, and the no-JS token green.

verdict-badge-wiring.spec.ts exits 0 with every row's .badge text and tone class matching the manifest and every docs href /components/{item.name}; the per-row copy affordance assertion holds for both labeled engine commands (2 per row, 112 total).
not-found-search-recovery.spec.ts exits 0 in all three projects with the header search opening through the single trigger element.
search-contract.spec.ts exits 0 in all three projects with the locked 13-step sequence and AC-1..AC-4 clicking the single trigger element.
must_not_observe: A strict-mode violation on any rewritten selector, a multi-match locator, or a timeout used to dodge a missing element.
Expected data hardcoded as literals replacing the dataset derivation, or a retired assertion that is not named and justified in the handoff.
A dev-server render (astro dev) or a stale dist standing in for the freshly built one.
red.json reporting (0) recorded failures or an empty failures array — the empty signature of a skipped capture.

requirements.name: Aggregate, static gates, diff boundary, and the proof harness evidence
requirements.description: GIVEN the repaired tree WHEN the aggregate pnpm test (vitest run) executes THEN it exits 0 — the vitest-class breaks repaired with no other suite regressed; pnpm typecheck exits 0; the scoped Biome command over the eight touched test files exits 0; the tracked-file diff is exactly the seven repaired suites plus the new harness, with only drill-appended run blocks under tests/sprint-05-orient-search/evidence/ORI-CI-001/ as the single-tutorial drill's own recording side effect; the harness records RED (the planner-verified trunk failures bound to the pre-change candidate SHA) and GREEN (per-suite exit 0) under .tmp/FIX-ORI-SUITE-1/; and no product source changes — scripts/docs-data/authored-snippets.ts mutations live and die inside the drill's owned scratch copies.
requirements.verification_service: the real vitest aggregate over the whole repository test tree, the real TypeScript compiler, the real Biome linter, and the harness's own spawned selectors

scenario.verification_service: the real vitest aggregate over the whole repository test tree, the real TypeScript compiler, the real Biome linter, and the harness's own spawned selectors

would_fail_if: The aggregate pnpm test exit 0 is claimed without running it, or is replaced by a partial vitest selection over only the repaired suites.
The harness spawns the aggregate pnpm test itself (unbounded recursion through the harness) instead of running it as a preserved command recorded in run.json.
A static-gate failure is recorded as environmental without the clean-env or righthook rerun proof, or a diff-boundary breach is hidden by stashing unrelated changes.

The proof harness is a stub — it returns authored pass records instead of spawning the seven real selectors and capturing their exit codes, or red.json/green.json are hand-written rather than emitted by the harness.
The harness omits the search-contract.spec.ts selector from its spawned set, so the seventh repair is claimed without a real selector run.

steps: Run the aggregate pnpm test on the repaired tree and record its exit code in run.json (the harness never spawns it — the implementer runs it as the preserved GREEN command).

Run pnpm typecheck and the scoped Biome command over the seven touched test files; prove any failure environmental (clean-env or righthook rerun) or pre-existing (git stash and rerun) before recording it.

Verify the tracked-file diff: exactly the six repaired suites plus the new harness, with only drill-appended run blocks under tests/sprint-05-orient-search/evidence/ORI-CI-001/ as the single-tutorial drill's own recording side effect, and zero product-source changes (apps/**, packages/**, scripts/** byte-unchanged on the candidate).

must_observe: The aggregate pnpm test exits 0 on the repaired tree — the vitest-class members of the six breaks repaired with no other suite regressed.
pnpm typecheck and the scoped Biome command exit 0 (or carry the stash-proven or clean-env-proven environmental record).
red.json, green.json, and run.json bind the candidate and harness sha256 values, the per-suite exit codes, the aggregate and static-gate exits, and the diff inventory; scratch roots are cleaned.
must_not_observe: A seventh failing vitest suite silently absorbed into the repair set without a scope report.
Any candidate-side product-source byte changed, or a path outside writeAllowed touched.
An empty or authored evidence record standing in for harness-observed exits — the (0)-count signature of a stub.
